clips.title: The story
paras: Elling Trias manages Trias' Cheese, a small storefront nestled in the bustling Trade District of Stormwind City. While he presents himself as a jovial and passionate purveyor of dairy, he quietly operates as one of the kingdom's most connected information brokers. Behind wheels of cheese and cordial banter, Trias maintains an ear to the ground that reaches across continents.

To the casual customer strolling the Trade District, Elling Trias is merely an artisan dedicated to fine curds, working his shop alongside his wife Elaine and son Ben. He enthusiastically hawks wheels of cheese and chats amicably with townsfolk. Yet those in the know understand that Trias' Cheese is one of the most reliable fronts in Stormwind. The steady hum of city commerce provides perfect cover for operatives, courtiers, and adventurers who need to trade quiet words without drawing the attention of the city watch.

Elling's network of informants and allies is staggering for a shopkeeper. He maintains ties with Master Mathias Shaw of SI:7, coordinates with Church contacts like Bishop DeLavey, and corresponds with agents as far afield as Darkshire, Theramore Isle, and the distant Plaguelands near Hearthglen. When odd rumors surface—whether concerning highway bandits or quiet movements in the countryside—Trias often pieces the puzzle together long before the royal court takes notice.
